text:
maria: quick sync — we need to pick a path for handling tenant burst smoothing + orphan token TTLs before next billing run.

alex: two strong options: deterministic bucketing at ingest (auditable) or smoothing in billing postprocess (no schema change).

sam: +1 for deterministic. Auditors request per-event determinism.

lee: watch out for replays/backfills. If bucketing uses ingest offset we break invoices on reingest. Use server-side charge_window_ts instead and preserve it on replays.

maria: proposal: add `charge_window_ts` (server ISO), optional `burst_shard` = hash(tenant_id)%N (opt-in), and flattened reconcile fields: `reconcile_status`, `reconcile_confidence`, `reconciler_run_id`. Default orphan TTL = 7d, per-tenant override.

alex: implement `burst_shard` as tinyint, opt-in per-tenant. Docs must explain aggregation semantics.

sam: reconciliation must emit audit events (flat fields) whenever we stitch/assign. auditors need replayability.

lee: consumers get a 14-day compatibility window. Backfill tool must be able to materialize `burst_shard` for historical events if tenant opts in retroactively.

maria: action items — Alex: schema PR; Sam: billing join changes preferring `charge_window_ts`; Lee: compatibility plan + cost estimate for extra fields/backfill; Billing-bot: UI/CSV changes.

billing-bot: noted — will coordinate with invoices team.

sam: quick poll: default `orphan_ttl_days` = 7 and `burst_shard` off by default. objections?

lee: -1 unless TTL shown on invoices.

alex: +1 if visible and configurable.

maria: ok we proceed with opt-in bucketing, default TTL=7d, flatten reconcile fields, and preserve charge_window_ts on replays. I'll post an RFC follow-up with schema and rollout timeline.

alex: linking perf note: https://redwood.internal/infradoc/metering-bucket-impact (will add numbers to PR).

maria: thanks — end thread.
